name: schema-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server for deterministic JSON Schema work: path-level diff between two schema versions with breaking vs non-breaking change classification, same-document $ref tracking, explicit not_supported reporting for dynamic keywords, and draft-07/2020-12 instance validation. Pure local computation: zero network, zero LLM, no hosted gateway.

tools.name: schema_diff
tools.description: Diff two JSON Schema versions at path level with breaking-change classification (required additions, type narrowing, enum removals, minimum tightening, pattern changes...). Same-document $ref inlined; unsupported constructs reported explicitly.

tools.name: schema_validate
tools.description: Validate a JSON instance document against a JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12, auto-detected). Sorted issues with instancePath/schemaPath/keyword.
